messages:
ashok: quick sanity check — can someone run a short microbench across A100/H100/L40S for model r2.1-quant? i'm seeing p99 spikes on L40S in staging.
maria: which workload? seq length / batch? commit?
ashok: 1 input, batch=8, seq=2048 (windowed). commit: 7f3b2e4 (runtime changes). command:
```bash
./run_microbench --model r2.1-quant --batch 8 --seq 2048 --iters 200 --warmups 20
```
bench-bot: job queued: microbench-1998765432-1. estimated 12m. i'll post results when done.
tim: if L40S p99 only shows up on seq>1024 might be cache/eviction. can you capture nvtx/nsys for one run? add --trace=nsys
ashok: good call. re-run now with --trace. will attach link.
bench-bot: results: A100 p50 12ms p99 28ms; H100 p50 9ms p99 24ms; L40S p50 11ms p99 92ms. logs: s3://redwood-bench/micro/1998765432/ (contains traces).
maria: wow L40S p99 is much higher. is it thermal throttling? what's GPU util? any stalls?
ashok: GPU util shows 65% avg, but nvlink/PCIe stalls visible. here's top lines from nsys:
```text
Host->Device memcpy spikes during KV cache fill: 450ms bursts
Kernel queue idle 60ms gaps
```
elaine: I can take traces tomorrow AM — will check memory allocation patterns & kernel scheduling. tagging @infra for NVLink diag.
infra: pinged infra team. if it's PCIe batching effect we might adjust batch size or prefetch. also try batch=4 run for L40S.
maria: can we get a quick smoke run with batch=4, seq=2048? if p99 drops, we might recommend batch cap for L40S.
bench-bot: job queued: microbench-1998765432-2 (batch=4). ETA 7m.
bench-bot: results: L40S batch=4 p50 13ms p99 30ms. that looks much closer to A100/H100. :white_check_mark:
tim: nice — suggests batching interacts badly with L40S PCIe. let's add note to runtime docs and make a config fallback: if device==L40S and batch>4 cap to 4.
ashok: created PR: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/483 (adds device-specific batch cap + telemetry). @maria @tim PTAL.
maria: :thumbsup: will review today.
elaine: i'll add a small integration test to make sure we don't regress.
